en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a small cargo vessel or coaster sailing on calm water near a low shoreline. The ship is seen in profile and appears to be carrying timber or similar deck cargo, stacked behind high wooden railings. It has a wheelhouse at the stern, two masts with rigging and wires, and a dark hull with a light-colored stripe near the bow. On the bow, the vessel's name "STÖR" is painted. The background shows a flat coastal landscape with scattered trees and buildings under an overcast sky.
